description: This file defines a Java interface 'Placeholder' parameterized with a generic type T. It models a placeholder expression used in templates or configurations, which can be resolved to a string value based on a source object. The interface extends another interface 'Expression' and provides a method 'resolve' to obtain the placeholder's value given a source object and a placeholder name.

classes.name: Placeholder
classes.description: An interface representing a placeholder expression of the format 'prefix:name' that can be resolved to a string value, given a source object of type T.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder variable by name from the given source object. Returns an Optional containing the value if supported, or an empty Optional otherwise.
